mapper.select: select business.*, ctr.id as ctr_id, ctr.user_id as ctr_user_id, ctr.business_id as ctr_business_id, ctr.track_status as ctr_track_status, ctr.key_items as ctr_key_items, ctr.next_time as ctr_next_time, ctr.record as ctr_record, ctr.create_time as ctr_create_time, u.name as ctr_assign_name from business left join business_track_record ctr on business.id = ctr.business_id left join user u on ctr.user_id = u.id where business.id = #{id} order by ctr.create_time desc
